title: reapi Custom Conditions — reapi-conditions

what: Real Estate API Request Modifiers — reapi_request_modifiers
title: Real Estate API Request Modifiers — reapi_request_modifiers
text: functions modify httr2::request() object add various features endpoints, authentication, user agent, body, error handling, retry logic, throttling, logging, caching, file saving. Functions: reapi_req_auth(): Adds authentication headers request. reapi_req_user_agent(): Sets user agent request. reapi_req_endpoint(): Adds endpoint request URL. reapi_req_body(): Sets body request JSON object. reapi_req_validate(): Validates request body specified endpoint's parameters. reapi_req_error(): Sets ReAPI-specific error handling request. reapi_req_retry(): Retries request fails due transient errors. reapi_req_throttle(): Applies throttling request. reapi_req_logger(): Attaches logger request object logging request details. reapi_req_cache(): Attaches custom cache feature request object caching responses. reapi_req_cache_key(): Derives cache key request based hash endpoint reapi_req_hash(): Generates hash request based components. reapi_req_file(): Generates file name saving request disk. reapi_req_resp_file(): Generates file name saving response disk.
